full_text:
Hey [@Advait Rane](/edgeware/account/m1dW5tK6mMKBZVtVqHyN5tRzeufNzHdNKmmbvt2FsunrFTC) and [@Vismay Joshi](/edgeware/account/mNh7aSGrMcVWXNEic8VDpoLTe1SWmhNa9eaC1umV3E4u3pm) - welcome to the project.

One immediate thing - more a general point, it's hard enough to get people to Commonwealth to read things, adding linked google docs where the key information is held just means there's an even greater drop off in people engaging.

Communication is key - and it's always worth remembering we have a crazy wide range of people, coming from different backgrounds, countries and with varying interests and the game we are playing is to get them more involved.

Maybe add some of the key stuff to this post - your intros are great, but it would be good to also see the scope in the same place or all context is removed...

I'd just add this section from the [attached google doc](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1GO2srdsHubKlo5Mxbr8rRUDXedkLuuFz8h6rFbUqiZU/edit#heading=h.ak6utt50slxz) to the post, then there can be an actual discussion about it. 

_**Scope of Work:**_
- _Modelling and communicating the token economics of the Edgeware blockchain, and also planning economic strategy based on the fast-paced development of the industry. _
- _Additionally, we would interact with the Edgeware community of users, offering compelling ideas and suggestions._
- _Providing financial oversight of Edgeware blockchain’s public treasury. This will include asset management recommendations. _
- _Work cross-functionally with legal thinkers, operational leads to produce general and nonspecific guidance to contributors in the Edgeware ecosystem._
- _Research on Edgeware’s inflation model and the optimal parameters for burning mechanism along with a hard cap for the total supply. _
- _Studies and statistical comparison based on runtime parameters of Edgeware solochain with other parachains._
- _Designing financial strategies for Edgeware Treasury funded projects._
- _More as per the real-time requirements._


A few initial questions to get started:

- _Providing financial oversight of Edgeware blockchain’s public treasury. This will include asset management recommendations. _


Could you elaborate? Its very broad - are there any areas you would like to focus on or assets you have in mind? 

- _Research on Edgeware’s inflation model and the optimal parameters for burning mechanism along with a hard cap for the total supply. _


Again would be great to elaborate here - the first half of the sentence is great - ie it's research based, but then it leaps into a conclusion "hard cap for total supply" 

As I understand it the work is research based - i'd steer away from assumptions, else you're starting with selection bias... answer first, and picking data to suit that conclusion. 

The joy of Edgeware's funding model is you can be paid to think outside the box and come to your own conclusions... 

- _Studies and statistical comparison based on runtime parameters of Edgeware solochain with other parachains._


Again could you simplify - explain this to me like i'm 10. Blockchain is primarily an industry of marketing hype, long words and pseudo academia. Making something more complicated is easy, simplifying stuff is where you really show you understand something. [Check this for an example](https://xkcd.com/thing-explainer/). 

- _Designing financial strategies for Edgeware Treasury funded projects._


Examples here would be great - what do you imagine this looks like? Again just to add some colour to your work.

Looking forward to your research!

body: Thanks for the suggestions Rich, really appreciate it. We will work on your Suggestions asap.
Welcome to the EDGE, hope you enjoy the view. Any new perspectives from the EDGE will be appreciated.
Thanks and Looking forward to it.
Welcome, and thank you for the intro! I think this will a super interesting research project and hopefully result in some actionable information for the EDG-sphere.
Sure, we will do our best.
